sentences.text: David Koepp -LRB- born June 9 , 1963 -RRB- is an American screenwriter and director .
Koepp is the fifth most successful screenwriter of all time in terms of U.S. box office receipts with a total gross of over $ 2.3 billion .

Koepp has achieved both critical and commercial success in a wide variety of genres : thriller , science fiction , comedy , action , drama , crime , superhero , horror , adventure , and fantasy .	thriller	Thriller film	science fiction	science fiction	comedy	comedy film	action	action film	drama	Drama (genre)	crime	crime film	superhero	superhero film	horror	horror film	adventure	adventure film	fantasy	Fantasy film
